segments.contextAfter: `completionHandler`: A block called after the restore image fetch has succeeded or failed. The `error` parameter passed to the block is `nil` if the image restoration was successful. The system invokes the completion handler on an arbitrary thread. The completion handler returns an `error` parameter that describes the reason for the failure; the block is `nil` if installation was successful.
